links.comparator_used: Flagged decisions from the same conformal model (no raw point-prediction or heuristic-cutoff arm was tested)
links.outcome: Residual harm rate among algorithmically cleared vs flagged decisions
links.effect: AUROC 0.80 (95% CI 0.78 to 0.82); 89.5% (95% CI 88.9% to 90.1%) of decisions cleared with 1.22% (95% CI 1.14% to 1.30%) residual harm vs 6.67% (95% CI 6.02% to 7.32%) for flagged decisions
links.quote: The conformal model achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.80 (95% CI 0.78 to 0.82), clearing 89.5% (95% CI 88.9% to 90.1%) of decisions with 1.22% (95% CI 1.14% to 1.30%) residual harm versus 6.67% (95% CI 6.02% to 7.32%) for flagged decisions.

design_hint: fairness-aware guardrails and conformal harm prediction gating
